title: YouTube & Podcast Summarizer
subtitle: AI Media Processing Automation
summary: A Python automation tool that collects YouTube and podcast content, transcribes audio with Whisper, and generates structured summaries with GPT.
cover_alt: YouTube and podcast AI summarization automation project cover

overview.title: Overview
paragraphs: YouTube & Podcast Summarizer is a Python automation project developed to collect media content from YouTube channels and podcast RSS feeds and transform it into structured summaries.

The workflow covers content discovery, date-based filtering, audio downloading, speech transcription with Whisper, and GPT-based summarization, allowing multiple channels to be processed through a repeatable pipeline.

responsibilities.title: Responsibilities
items: Analyze client requirements and define the end-to-end media processing workflow.
Implement YouTube channel URL parsing, channel information retrieval, and video discovery.
Build podcast RSS feed discovery and date-based episode filtering.
Download audio content using yt-dlp and podcast media URLs.
Integrate OpenAI Whisper for audio transcription.
Integrate GPT-3.5 for transcript summarization and analysis.
Support processing multiple channels in a single execution and organize outputs by channel and media title.

technical_highlights.title: Technical Highlights
paragraphs: The project combines media discovery, audio processing, speech recognition, and language-model summarization into a single automated workflow for both YouTube and podcast sources.

items.title: Supporting different media sources
items.description: YouTube channels and podcast RSS feeds expose content through different structures, requiring separate collection and filtering logic before entering the same processing pipeline.

items.title: Processing long-form transcripts
items.description: Transcribed media content could be too large to summarize directly, so transcripts needed to be divided into smaller sections before their summaries were combined into a final result.

items.title: Creating a practical batch workflow
items.description: The tool needed to support multiple channels while keeping generated transcripts and summaries organized in predictable output directories.

outcome.title: Outcome
paragraphs: The completed tool automated the workflow from media discovery to structured text output for both YouTube and podcast content.
It supported multiple channel inputs, organized results automatically, and generated summaries containing both key content and future outlook sections.

lessons_learned.title: Lessons Learned
items: Breaking a media-processing workflow into independent stages makes integration and troubleshooting easier.
Different content platforms require source-specific collection logic even when the downstream processing workflow is shared.
Long-form AI processing requires managing input size and combining intermediate results into a coherent final output.
Small workflow improvements such as predictable output paths and batch processing can significantly improve usability for the end user.
